query:
SELECT u.id, u.name, u.email, ut.tenantId, t.name as tenantName 
FROM users u 
LEFT JOIN user_tenants ut ON u.id = ut.userId 
LEFT JOIN tenants t ON ut.tenantId = t.id 
ORDER BY u.createdAt DESC LIMIT 5;
